notes.title: Untold Tales Presents - Summer Game-Fiesta
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/86e78c86c91048528e462fb4a376c7971f84a76d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/f7c3eb79e1661724e66c0254bbe68cc030f8ff1d.png[/img]
[h3]Greetings, fellow gamers![/h3]
[b]Before we all go full summer mode chilling out on the beach this is the time when we can enjoy the summertime-gaming-fiesta filled with releases, sales and new surprises straight from the Untold Tales world![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/392ee1f0d8546543f4f64db832bb689e5d9ce084.png[/img]
[h3]Since our last episode of Untold Tales Presents, we’ve released the following gaming goodies:[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1374230/Flame_Keeper

The moment you've all been waiting for is finally here! Flame Keeper is blazing out of early access and into full release with version 1.0! Get ready to ignite your gaming spirit as we introduce the Prophet, a wise villager who's seen more than a few winters and will guide you through the new Cloud biome, where you'll find icy islands that make winter wonderlands look like beach vacations. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2225610/Ready_Steady_Ship/

Experience conveyor belt mayhem like never before, tackle the challenges of the factory floor, from operating and fixing malfunctioning machinery to navigating treacherous obstacles and prepare for the upcoming Let’s Party Update, which brings seven new minigames to the factory on June 28th.



https://store.steampowered.com/app/1227650/BangOn_Balls_Chronicles/

The Wild West Map has just hit town, and it's a real humdinger! We're talking 5 diverse regions to explore, each with its unique flavor. From the dusty saloons to the treacherous oil fields, there's somethin' for everyone!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/be94a1e819b9e098761440ca12ca3a7a29d59f97.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2473640/EcoGnomix/

[h3]Channel your inner Gnome and get ready for EcoGnomix! [/h3]
Build a covert business empire, by looting the underground world with a team of gnomes, combine upgrades strategically to help your gnomes survive an unlimited supply of mystical caves with unique flora and fauna. The future of our gnomes is in your hands!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/cb333a10276e81714b48cf6c1e7fbaf5d0adfe12.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=VuIPqL-GCeU;full][/previewyoutube][h3]The sun-soaked shores of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/untoldtales/sale/untoldtales2024]Untold Tales Publisher Sale[/url] await you![/h3]
Explore diverse worlds, engage in captivating stories, and experience unforgettable gameplay.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/42192/Untold_Tales_Treasures__30_for_30/
[h3]On top of that, we’ve launched the Untold Tales Treasures - a special gaming bundle filled with our titles, each designed with one ultimate goal: to deliver a unique gaming experience that will leave a lasting impression.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/e6138e06f05a18fb75e4e89bfe8fbcde94ba4454.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39873559/bff53bbb136d69eebfd0dcaf1119dc020882e85c.png[/img]
[h3]There never was a better chance to show off your balls to your friends![/h3]
Thanks to our collaboration with GimmeSwag we created the Ultimate Bang-On Balls: Chronicles plushie coming at you straight from the Roman Army. 
[b]Secure your Roman Army plushie today at [url=https://www.gimmeswag.com/products/bang-on-balls-plush?utm_source=In-Game&utm_medium=Pop+Up&utm_campaign=BoB+Roman+Army+Plush]GimmeSwag Store[/url]![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/b0d402a26a751b30d1566f5b349dec7304800e2c.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=l47gcVdtBAg;leftthumb][/previewyoutube] 
[i][b]Greetings all you Tesla City Martians out there! [/b][/i]

Put on your headphones just like you would a radio helmet, and get ready to immerse yourself in the world of The Cub with all episodes of Radio Nostalgia Broadcast. 

[i]Dive into survivor stories blended with a harmonious tapestry of apocalypse-wave melodies.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/e255a95cc853e47c1cfbdd55de631d93bcab92ca.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/5329ead788c53db121d72d8a24578400a336845c.png[/img]
We're almost halfway through the year and we've traveled a lot, not only virtually.
Be sure to follow our socials where we are going to share some cool spots we've already seen and give you some hints about the next stop for our Teddy on Tour.

See you on our socials 
[url=https://www.facebook.com/untoldtalesgames]Facebook[/url] / [url=https://twitter.com/UntoldTalesHQ]Twitter[/url]  / [url=https://www.instagram.com/untoldtaleshq/]Instagram[/url] / [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@untoldtales.games]TikTok[/url] / [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UChrqRdrw-oNv-AXVMOwa1yw]YouTube[/url]

[b]Your continued support means the world to us![/b][i]
Previously on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/41232016/view/5923994639407330574?l=english]Untold Tales Presents[/url] [/i]

notes.title: Giants Uprising - Update 1.2.1
notes.content:
[h1]Update 1.2.1 is live![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35530428/b1835dfc450d445208f57b5b9fa43ce6682664b6.png[/img]

[h2]Changelog:[/h2]
[olist]
[*] [b]Walk replaced with run[/b] (that doesn't use stamina bar) by default.

[*] [b]Charge is now one button-press instead of two[/b] (no need to hold attack button to do so). 
Thus overall speed of the gameplay increased. No changes regarding stamina usage.

[*] [b]Default controls on gamepad changed[/b] (actions mentioned above taken into account)

[*] [b]Level Design changes:[/b]
- the Player now faces correct direction when reloading the very last checkpoint
- issues regarding falling under the map have been fixed

[*] [b]Tutorial[/b] can be skipped now.

[*] [b]VSync[/b] has been implemented.

[*] [b]Lightning[/b] has been reworked on every map.

[*] Character models now interact with foliage.
[/olist]

We are greatful for your constant support, advice and requests both on social media and Steam Discussions alike. We're already planning the next update and we're always happy to get in touch with you, so do not hestitate to share your thoughts with us!

[h3]We've made a trailer especially for this occasion:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=aZdxZFmnJSY;full][/previewyoutube]

Happy hunting!

Our social media: [url=https://linktr.ee/giantsuprising]https://linktr.ee/giantsuprising[/url]

notes.title: UPDATE 1.1.0 is now live!
notes.content:
Dear Giants,

We are happy to finally release a 1.1.0 patch for Giants Uprising. We hope, that added functionalities will make the game more pleasurable and accessible for you, feel free to share your thoughts on our official Discord server. At this point, however, we would like to state, that not all of the functionalities promised in the roadmap are present in this update. This is mainly due to the fact, that for the past 3 weeks some members of our team and their families were dealing with Covid-19 and had to take care of their health. The health, comfort, and safety of our colleagues and their close ones are very important for us. This situation did affect our internal schedule, but nevertheless, we decided to publish the patch in a stable state, but without some functionalities or with some minor issues occurring. This way you, our Users, can enjoy more content in Giants Uprising, but we also want to be honest and we hope for your understanding. Be well and stay safe, more info and updates will come in 2022, stay tuned!

[i]Giants Uprising Development Team[/i]


[b]Here are the patchnotes: [/b]

[b]Update 1.1.0[/b]

[u]General:[/u]
- Complex optimization throughout the whole game (f.e. VFX and meshes complexity)
- Optimized Small AI and their complexity
- Additional tutorial level has been added at the beginning of the game
- [b]New level: Night Fever[/b]
- [b]New level: Supply Run[/b]
- New Tower type: Searchlight
- Fullscreen tutorials now appear when any new mechanic is introduced for the first time
- Rogbar now turns his head towards points of interest
- Some of the UI elements have been animated for better visibility

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35530428/4eca2f957104c9843cac6fc78591915c197b21bf.png[/img]

[u]Main Menu:[/u]
- [b]Customization[/b] (beta version) tab has been added to the Main Menu
- Re-arranged missions order in Mission Mode World View

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35530428/0ceabaf4896644b7564de252acdddacdc23ac494.png[/img]

[u]Options:[/u]
- [b]Localization[/b]: Polish, French, Italian, Spanish, German, Russian
- The User is now able to [b]change the input buttons, invert axis[/b] x/y
- The User is now able to change the gamepad and mouse sensitivity

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35530428/b9e656928761ba05fab941075df8297b5d905bc6.png[/img]

[u]Blood & Sand level[/u]
- Lighting throughout the level has been optimized and rebuilt

[u]Fair Fun Level[/u]
- Lighting throughout the level has been optimized and rebuilt
- Foliage has been reduced

[u]Borderlands on Fire level[/u]
- Lighting throughout the level has been optimized and rebuilt

[u]Homecoming level:[/u]

- Number of Towers and Small AI has been reduced at the beginning of the level


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35530428/1f0e993780f2a1a53bad2bcc3ceb2a7295a6da97.png[/img]

Have fun, Giants!

notes.title: Giants Uprising - PATCH 1.0.2
notes.content:
[b]Update 1.0.2[/b]

General:
- Slight optimization throughout the whole game (f.e. VFX and meshes complexity and skirts of Slaver-type giants)

- Increased meat health recovery from 40% to 50%
- Display of version in the upper right corner of the screen has been added

Blood & Sand level
- Damage received from Giants AI has been reduced
- You can now destroy the doors directly, without having to walk into the waypoint in front of them first
- Space outside of the arena has been properly meshed
- Overall Lightning has been changed
- Torches pointing the way have been properly positioned near the destroyable doors
- Navigational dialogues have been added

Borderlands on Fire level
- Palisades have been erased near the end of the Level
- Decreased number of towers and soldiers near the end of the level
- Trigger areas for the first anchoring traps have been enlarged

Homecoming level:
- Disabled the objective marker in the labirynth 
- Dizziness effect has been visibly reduced

[u]Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/trAKHz7grq[/u]

notes.title: Update from the team - 15 Nov 2021
notes.content:
Dear Giants,

We are finishing our work on repairing the Save System, along with a few other optimisation issues and crashes. Tomorrow the patch will be published on Steam, however BEWARE - although this patch does fix some of the issues reported to us in the last two weeks, our changes to the Save System require erasing all of the User's current progress, as saves that were created beforehand are corrupted and will not cooperate with the new tweaks included in the patch, therefore this action is necessary to avoid any other potential issues. 
We are sorry for this inconvenience, but we truly hope that you will give our title a second chance, as this patch makes our game a bit more approachable.

Giants Uprising Development Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35530428/f48afc58fd2ccf0cfc0dc6d2c5bc1d448dee5bd9.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35530428/1f0e993780f2a1a53bad2bcc3ceb2a7295a6da97.png[/img]
If you would like to stay updated, join our Discord: https://discord.gg/trAKHz7grq

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 for Giants Uprising is now available
notes.content:
Dear Giants,

We are still solving the issues regarding optimization, we solved some of them, but due to the lack of possibility to perform proper compatibility tests, proper optimization process might take a little longer. If the game running on maximum graphics settings does not let you to fully enjoy the experience, we recommend going into the "options" sub-menu in order to lower the settings. We do understand, that this is only a half-measure, but we will do everything we can in order to replace it with proper solution as fast as possible.

Our tests also resulted in tracking down some issues regarding the various graphic cards, please make sure that:
- You are using the latest drivers for your graphic card
- You are using the latest DirectX
- (Laptops only) You are using a proper graphic card, not an integrated one

[i]Sorry for the troubles and thank you for your understanding and support.[/i]



[b]Patch 1.0.1 for Giants Uprising is now available on PC - Steam. Here's the list of changes for this update.[/b]
Please note that the issues listed below did not affect all players.

[b]General:[/b]
- Fixed an issue with camera clamping in Skill Tree view
- Fixed an issue with cannon's collision after destroying the towers
- Dialogue informing about low health has been disabled
- Humans falling out of destroyed buildings have been disabled (SFX stayed)
- Death screen has been disabled, checkpoint is now automatically loaded
- Fixed an issue with Quest Log's visual offset
- "Damage received" animation can be cancelled much earlier than before
- Bunch of Audio issues has been solved
- Story Missions now have proper description in World Map view
- Added navigation UI in the World Map view
- Slight optimization with destruction
- If the save is made with Rogbar having less than 10% of health, loading the game will refill health to 10%
- Rebalance damage of Cannon Towers
- Giant Hunters deal less starting damage
- Added low life UI life bar animation
- Added low life meat UI animation
- Added UI animation for picking up the meat
- Added UI animation for eating up the meat

[b]Blood and Sand[/b]
- Fixed the issue with being stuck in metal gate after destroying the very first wooden doors
- Improved chasing Giants AI
- Chasing Giants no longer use superman punch
- Damage dealt by Chasing Giants has been lowered
- Enlarged width of waypoints
- The User is now able to progress even after missing a waypoint by destroying wooden doors
- Changed the number of cows required to interact from 3 to 2
- Rebalanced damage of Giants primary attack with fists

notes.title: Update from the team! 🚨
notes.content:
Dear Giants,

We see your struggles, we hear your opinion. By the end of this week, a patch containing fixes for the most severe issues will land on Steam. 

Additionally, by the end of November, we will increase accessibility of our product by: 
- overhauling "Options" sub-menu, 
- allowing to enter "Options" sub-menu from in-game pause menu,
- allowing to re-bind the controls to your own need

Thank you for your reports, we will do everything in order to make Giants Uprising more pleasant for you. 

If you find any more issues, feel free to join our Discord server and lets us know about the problem on the "bugs" channel or write an e-mail on feedback.gu@varsav.com with the description of a problem, any videos or screenshots will also be helpful.

Giants Uprising Development Team

[u]If you would like to stay updated, join our Discord: [/u] https://discord.gg/trAKHz7grq
